name: Harley-Davidson Sportster Ironhead
engine: 1000 cc air-cooled Ironhead V-twin, one carb, chain drive
intro: The cast-iron-head Sportster. Simple, but most have been through several cheap owners.

add.title: Check the engine cases
add.instructions: Look for cracks, stripped threads and broken bolts in the cases. On pre-1973 cases, check the lower right transmission area near the speedometer drive.
add.reason: Cracked or mismatched cases cause leaks and gearbox trouble.

A: Many Ironheads have had several owners who skimped on parts. Check what has been changed before you trust anything.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Engine cases
known.what: Early cases crack near the speedometer drive, and mismatched cases cause gearbox wear.
